name: Kingstar KKWB017 Wardrobe
description: Spacious 2-door Kingstar wardrobe with hanging rail, shelves and drawer. Made from melamine board. Ideal for bedroom storage.
details: The Kingstar KKWB017 is a practical 2-door wardrobe designed for everyday bedroom use. It features a full hanging rail at the top, multiple open shelves and a small internal drawer for organised storage. The dark wood-grain melamine finish gives a smart, modern look. Strong construction with locking doors and silver handles makes it a reliable and stylish choice for Sri Lankan homes.
